about: The 5M improvement loop (Adam, 20 Oct 2026): keep every current gain, add the missing chat abilities, loop the 5M to its best before the 100M. research_side/loop_5m.py runs the rounds in order: BASE of recipes/BEST.json + ONE change, seed 1 -> full suite + new tests -> compare with the best's two seeds; seed 2 only for a win with no front lost; a two-seed NEW BEST is adopted into BEST.json and later rounds build on it. A round runs when ready (code written and smoke-tested).
new_tests_plan: suite sections, run with --tag _ev2new on every candidate and on the best's seeds (baselines): twomem (told personal fact + stored real fact), reason (count, order, summary over the conversation), afterno (answers after a refusal), phrasing (200 real-phrasing cases, held out from training phrasings), probe2 (the 32-question probe rewritten for the real store), open (open-ended answers vs references: overlap, completeness, repetition)

after_loop: 100M preparation: gradient accumulation in chat22/train.py, rope scaling 1,024 -> 2,048, a short run measuring speed and GPU memory within 3/4, the 100M data plan rebuilt from BEST.json (same kinds and shares, sized for about one pass). The 100M training itself starts when Adam says go.
